caption: Bowen Engineering Corp. v. Estate of Reeve
citation_line: Bowen Engineering Corp. v. Estate of Reeve, 799 F. Supp. 467 (D.N.J. 1992)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Thompson resolved cross-motions in a CERCLA and contractual-indemnity dispute concerning contamination at a former testing laboratory, addressing responsible-party liability, cleanup costs, corporate obligations and Rule 11 sanctions.
qualification_rationale: The opinion is a durable part of Judge Thompson’s career. A 2024 Judicature profile by Third Circuit Judge Thomas Hardiman identified it as one of her noteworthy opinions and reported that it had been cited more than 400 times.
appellate_posture_note: The selection rests on sustained judicial influence rather than Supreme Court or precedential appellate review.
